---
title: "Comparison of Virus Abundance Detection between HybCapSeq and MetaT"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r }
# Load required packages
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice)  # For PPTX output

# Load data
data_file <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/HybCapSeq_vs_MetaT_group_sampleID_Total_RPKMF.tsv",
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)
virus_data <- fread(data_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# Convert 'group' column to factor with meaningful labels
virus_data$group <- factor(virus_data$group, levels = c("Yes", "No"), 
                          labels = c("Capture", "Non-capture"))

# Calculate average RPKMF for each sample
sample_avg_rpkmf <- virus_data %>%
  group_by(sampleID) %>%
  summarise(avg_rpkmf = mean(Total_RPKMF)) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_rpkmf))

# Order samples by average RPKMF in descending order
virus_data$sampleID <- factor(virus_data$sampleID, 
                             levels = sample_avg_rpkmf$sampleID)

# Create bar plot with logarithmic scale and ordered samples
p_virus <- ggplot(virus_data, aes(x = sampleID, y = Total_RPKMF + 1, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  # Add strain count labels above bars
  geom_text(aes(label = strains, y = Total_RPKMF + 1), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12)) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "Sample ID",
    y = "Total viral RPKMF (Number of viral strains detected)",
    fill = "Detection method"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log10",
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
    labels = c("0", expression(10^1), expression(10^2), 
               expression(10^3), expression(10^4)),
    limits = c(1, 10000)
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = "gray"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = c(0.95, 0.95),
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Capture" = "#3573A1FF", "Non-capture" = "#3AAEADFF"),
    labels = c("HybCapSeq", "MetaT")
  )

# Display the plot
print(p_virus)

# Save the plot as PDF and PPTX
output_dir <- sprintf("%s/charts/", find_rstudio_root_file())
ggsave(
  filename = "HybCapSeq_vs_MetaT_VirusAbundance.pdf",
  plot = p_virus,
  path = output_dir,
  width = 12,
  height = 6
)

topptx(
  p_virus,
  filename = sprintf("%s/HybCapSeq_vs_MetaT_VirusAbundance.pptx", output_dir),
  height = 6,
  width = 12
)


```
